run_render_panoIR: run the PanoIR rendering pipeline to generate visual and acoustic observations for MP3D scenes
create_make_configuration: create a Habitat-Sim simulator configuration with RGB and depth sensors for a given scene
build_visual_render: build panoramic RGB and depth images by rendering from multiple camera angles at a receiver position
build_acoustic_render: build acoustic impulse response observations between a source and receiver position in the scene
summarize_get_res_angles_for: summarize the resolution and camera angles for a given field-of-view value
